rooms.name: Hearth Landing
rooms.first: The close hearth court frames the western mill and a northeast glimpse of the receiver stacks across the collapsed drainage cut
rooms.activity: Plaque, bank, altar and reward remain together; their proposed positions are explicit in the migration table
rooms.learn: This was a workers' refuge between the wet and hot works
rooms.onward: West to metalwork and the stock court; northeast to the quay; the foundry return makes a short completion loop
rooms.difference: Small protected human-scale landing, not a central empty square

rooms.name: Hammer Gallery
rooms.first: A diagonal approach reveals the mill flywheel and its working aisle before the furnace mouth
rooms.activity: Existing Forge service at proposed30,40 and anvil33,42; press/bench remain a non-interactive production display until binding review
rooms.learn: Slate and ore arrived on a short tramway; the press and benches share a protected maintenance gallery
rooms.onward: Follow the tram upstream into the cut, or return through the oblique arch to the hearth
rooms.difference: Compressed stone-and-timber work bay, open to the excavation rather than boxed apart

rooms.name: The Slate Cut
rooms.why: Obtain copper/tin and explore extraction traces
rooms.first: Broken strata and a braced working face rise behind the rail buffer
rooms.activity: The same four copper/tin resource types, explicitly relocated along a broken seam; no new resource or mining rule
rooms.learn: The facility grew around the rock seam; spoil and a failed retaining wall explain the dogleg
rooms.onward: Rail leads back to the mill; drainage and a collapsed retaining arch lead into the moss basin
rooms.difference: Geological edges interrupt masonry rhythm; no mining-room rectangle

rooms.name: Leakwater Basin
rooms.why: Optional gathering/exploration and a cool relief from industry
rooms.first: Drips beneath the failed return culvert, not vegetation spread uniformly over a green tile square
rooms.activity: Existing four tree sites; optional side loop and maintenance overlook
rooms.learn: A failed water return fed soil pockets and split the western retaining wall
rooms.onward: A dry raised edge returns to the cut; an overlook foreshadows the foundry without bypassing combat unlocks
rooms.landmark: Broken culvert and a tree rooted in the wall
rooms.difference: Vegetation follows water and shade; dry ground remains slate/ash

rooms.name: Headgate Quay
rooms.why: Restore Kitchen, fish and learn coolant
rooms.first: An inset working quay and pump intake; the channel continues into the plant perimeter
rooms.activity: Four existing fishing NPCs using the unchanged3tileapproach; proposed range61,59 and training coolant62,60
rooms.learn: Water drives and cools the works; the pump supply physically leads toward the furnaces
rooms.onward: Dry walk north to the pressure gallery; return south to optional stores or west to the hearth
rooms.difference: A working inlet with a shaped bank, not a rectangular swimming pool

rooms.name: Pressure Walk
rooms.why: Read danger and approach the late encounters
rooms.first: A kinked low gallery passes beneath an overhead coolant main; furnace light is framed ahead
rooms.activity: Existing vent/coolant teaching and encounter approach; no new damage or gate rules
rooms.learn: Cool return and hot exhaust are different systems, marked by material and direction
rooms.onward: East to Imp then back along the manifold to the Warden threshold
rooms.difference: Narrow safe ledge beside a lowered non-walkable heat trench; no decorative obstacle in combat bounds

rooms.name: Provision Yard
rooms.why: Optional early food/combat and supply exploration
rooms.first: A damaged loading wall and abandoned covered store
rooms.activity: Existing chicken spawns retained; no new NPCs or drops
rooms.learn: This was the workforce's provision court, not part of the molten process
rooms.onward: Broken cart path joins the quay and landing
rooms.difference: Dry outdoor earth pockets, broken perimeter and inward-looking shelter

rooms.name: Old Stock Court
rooms.first: Low ruined enclosure beneath the workshop wall
rooms.activity: Existing cattle/bone opportunities. A fresh self-supplied run needs bones for Altar; choose this court or the provision yard, without requiring both
rooms.learn: Service yards were added around the earlier stone works
rooms.onward: Short path reaches the forge and altar; no enforced tour through both courts
rooms.difference: Low sightlines and usable open ground instead of a decorated combat box

rooms.name: Vent Retort
rooms.why: Defeat the Imp after the three services
rooms.first: A furnace sidewall and exhaust array surround an uncluttered dark floor
rooms.activity: Imp at proposed68,71 with the same8x8arena and translated quiet vent anchors
rooms.learn: The minor guardian occupies the exhaust system feeding the main foundry
rooms.onward: Follow the manifold around the drainage cut to the receiver's south threshold
rooms.landmark: Retort flue at the east edge
rooms.difference: A compact attached plant bay, not a second isolated boss showroom

rooms.name: The Great Receiver
rooms.why: Face the Warden after the Imp
rooms.first: The paired furnace stacks and a curved load-bearing rear receiver frame the arena across a low threshold
rooms.activity: Warden at proposed81,56;13x11arena75..87/51..61 and four relative coolant positions preserved
rooms.learn: Every rail, coolant line and flue belongs to the facility's central production heart
rooms.onward: The short dry completion return reaches reward51,41 and portal60,50 without retracing the whole wet loop
rooms.landmark: Twin flues, central receiver and cool barrel insets
rooms.difference: Monumental outer silhouette wraps a clear gameplay rectangle; no intrusive arena dressing

rooms.name: Broken Approach
rooms.why: Optional supply circuit and the repeat-arrival approach
rooms.first: A broken retaining wall frames the sanctuary arch, with the foundry stacks beyond
rooms.activity: Repeat-arrival56,49 remains accessible; early courts stay optional
rooms.learn: The once-straight haul road has been diverted around a collapsed footing
rooms.onward: Clear two-tile dry connections to both resource yards and the landing
rooms.landmark: Missing span and split haul road
rooms.difference: A repaired dogleg route; no long axial rectangle

anchor_policy: Explicit relocations permit a fundamentally different layout. Preserve mechanics and arena-relative dimensions; do not mistake current coordinates for engine limits. Implement only after review, with coordinate configuration, persistence relocation and native validation.
gameplay_order: Forge/Kitchen/Altar in any order, then Imp, then Warden, then existing reward/exit. Illustrated exploration order is not a new quest gate.
elevations: Keep interaction/combat plane0 and core floor nativeY-240. Quay water0; a proposed64unit maintenance rise remains outside encounter bounds. Overhead main minimum320units above lanes. Trench/central drainage cut nonwalkable. No new stacked-plane bridge.
